dataset_name: Kolkata Durga Puja 2026 General Ritual Schedule
purpose: Provide general ritual dates and broad timing windows from published Kolkata Panjika references. For exact timings at an individual pandal, direct users to that pandal's verified official website or Facebook page.

source_policy.general_timings: Use Panjika-derived dates, tithi boundaries, and broad ritual windows. Record the Panjika tradition for every tradition-dependent value.
source_policy.local_pandal_timings: Do not guess exact local schedules. Find a nearby pandal from the user's supplied location and provide only a verified official website or Facebook page URL recorded for that pandal.
source_policy.missing_local_schedule: Exact local pandal timings are not stored in this dataset. Direct users to the relevant nearby pandal's verified official website or Facebook page using the separate official-page mapping. If no verified URL is available, state that clearly.
source_policy.conflicting_panjikas: Keep tradition-specific dates and times as separate records. Never average, merge, or present conflicting times as one universal time.
source_policy.time_precision: A broad label such as morning, evening, or before a tithi boundary is not an exact pandal start time.
source_policy.source_verification: Store a source title, publisher, URL, source type, and verification date for every reported time window.
